newsitem.title: UK: Siemens euro Eurobonds seen at 2.0 bln marks.
newsitem.headline: Siemens euro Eurobonds seen at 2.0 bln marks.

text.p: The three Siemens AG Eurobonds, which will be simultaneously issued in French francs, guilders and marks and be redenominated in euros after EMU, will total up to 2.0 billion marks equivalent, lead manager J.P. Morgan Securities said on Friday.
The deals will have a 10-year maturity and are due for launch early next week.
Deutsche Morgan Grenfell will be joint lead manager on all three tranches. Paribas will also lead on the franc deal and ABN AMRO Hoare Govett will be joint lead on the guilder deal.
The offering will be Aaa/AAA rated Siemens first syndicated fixed income public transaction in more than 25 years, J.P. Morgan said in a statement earlier.
The three deals will be fungible into one euro Eurobond after EMU, J.P. Morgan said.
